newsitem.title: UK: John Lewis UK store sales up 12.4% in latest week.
newsitem.headline: John Lewis UK store sales up 12.4% in latest week.

text.p: The John Lewis Partnership JLP.CN said its UK department store sales rose 12.4 percent in the week to February 8 compared with the same week a year earlier.
In the two weeks to February 8, sales were up 8.5 percent year-on-year.
The estimate for department store sales in the first half of this financial year is up 6.4 percent on last year.
Total sales including those from the Waitrose supermarket chain rose 8.3 percent in the week to February 8, and were up 6.2 percent in the two week period year on year.
The estimate for total sales in the current half year is up 6.2 percent on last year.
